newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND'S HANDLOWY RATES SLASKI AS "BUY".
newsitem.headline: POLAND'S HANDLOWY RATES SLASKI AS "BUY".

text.p: Investors with mid-term investment horizons should buy shares of Poland's Bank Slaski SA, which could rise to 400-450 zlotys in the long-term, the brokerage unit of Bank Handlowy SA said in a report.
The report dated December 20 and released to the media on Monday said the bank should benefit from its cooperation with strategic investor ING Bank .

"The cooperation with ING will undoubtedly contribute to raising the quality of services offered by Bank Slaski, and will also contribute to strengthening the bank's position in relation to competition from Polish and foreign banks," Handlowy said.
It said Slaski's strong position in Upper Silesia, one of the most important economic regions in Poland, also bode well for the bank's future growth.
Handlowy said Slaski's net profit, estimated at 315 million zlotys in 1996, was likely to rise to 376.7 million in 1997
Slaski traded at 327 zlotys on Monday.
